Massive Israeli Assault on Lebanon Threatens U.S.-Iran Ceasefire (by Lylla Younes). Over 250 people were killed in what the Israeli military said was the “largest coordinated strike” on Lebanon since March 2.
Iran war ceasefire announced amid sporadic attacks; Israel bombards Lebanon in “largest coordinated strike”; Democrats expand majority on Wisconsin supreme court (by Drop Site News)

Iran, Lebanon, and the Destruction of Civilian Life (by Drop Site News). Drop Site's Sharif Abdel Kouddous and Murtaza Hussein discuss the latest in Iran with Professor Sina Azodi, and Lebanon with journalist Lylla Younes.
